description: This file defines the interface for the OpenCDMSystem class, which provides methods for managing DRM systems, sessions, and related cryptographic data within a media application. It includes virtual functions for retrieving key system information, creating sessions, and managing DRM stores.
external_methods: OpenCDMSession *createSession(const LicenseType, OpenCDMSessionCallbacks *, void *, const std::string &, const std::vector<uint8_t> &)

classes.name: OpenCDMSystem
classes.description: An abstract class representing the DRM system interface, providing methods for session creation, key management, and metadata retrieval.

methods.name: keySystem
methods.description: Returns the key system identifier as a string.

methods.name: metadata
methods.description: Returns metadata associated with the DRM system.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates a new DRM session with specified license type, callbacks, and initialization data.

methods.name: getLdlSessionsLimit
methods.description: Retrieves the limit on the number of sessions.

methods.name: getKeyStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the key store.

methods.name: getDrmStoreHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash of the DRM store.
